session.instructions:
An original adult female voice in her mid-twenties, speaking native standard Japanese. Radiant, glamorous, honey-warm mid register with a relaxed, languid, affectionately coaxing drawl. Lush and silky timbre, unhurried tempo, softly elongated vowels and a breathy, playful sweet-spoiled lilt at the ends of phrases, effortlessly charming and at ease.
Speak immediately in Japanese. Say exactly this line once: "ああっ……す、すごい……頭が、真っ白になるっ……！". Do not translate, paraphrase, repeat, or add words. Then remain silent. Delivery direction: Sudden overwhelmed dramatic cry of astonishment and breathless tremor, voice catching emotionally at the end, anime drama acting. No music or background noise. Enunciate every syllable clearly and remain silent immediately after finishing.
